breakouts.h: Breakout watch: 12 players ready to make the leap
breakouts.d: Rating jumps from offseason training, new starting jobs, scheme fits and what they did with limited snaps last year. These are the names to know before kickoff.

list.name: N.Pullard
list.d: [[p:557719002|N.Pullard]] slides into the starting lineup with J.Joseph gone. Better yet, he jumped from 75 to 79 overall this offseason. And he saw his man coverage (83 to 87) and press coverage (71 to 75) take a big step in training. By October, everyone will know it.

list.name: M.Goodman
list.d: [[p:557715432|M.Goodman]] is penciled in as a starter for the first time. On top of that, he saw his pass blocking (84 to 88) and power pass protection (88 to 92) take a big step in training. And he brings a agile skill set to a scheme that ranks 15th in total offensive yards per game. By October, everyone will know it.

list.name: B.Jackson
list.d: [[p:557716657|B.Jackson]] ran for 6.6 yards a carry as a backup. On top of that, Ohio State leans on the run game (6th in rushing yards per game last year). And he brings a east/west playmaker skill set to a scheme that ranks 9th in rushing yards per game. By October, everyone will know it.

list.name: D.Hardeman Jr.
list.d: [[p:557715799|D.Hardeman Jr.]] slides into the starting lineup with J.Patterson gone. Add this: Rice leans on the run game (7th in rushing yards per game last year). And he ran for 7.4 yards a carry as a backup. Don't be surprised to see him on an all-conference team.

list.name: N.Dean
list.d: [[p:557714135|N.Dean]] slides into the starting lineup with K.Davis and L.Porter IV gone. Better yet, he saw his hands (83 to 88) and catching in traffic (77 to 82) take a big step in training. And he averaged 21.8 yards a catch in a limited role. Kennesaw State fans are about to get a new favorite player.

list.name: D.Wilson
list.d: [[p:557723180|D.Wilson]] averaged 17.0 yards a catch in a limited role. Also: Florida threw it more than almost anyone last year (5th in passing yards per game). He brings a contested specialist skill set to a scheme that ranks 20th in receptions. Circle his name now.

list.name: T.Washington Jr.
list.d: [[p:557722653|T.Washington Jr.]] slides into the starting lineup with T.Maddox gone. Also: UL Monroe leans on the run game (18th in rushing yards per game last year). And he ran for 6.7 yards a carry as a backup. This is the year.

list.name: M.Lightfoot
list.d: [[p:557717747|M.Lightfoot]] is penciled in as a starter for the first time. Better yet, he saw his block shedding (73 to 77) and pursuit (89 to 93) take a big step in training. And he brings a speed rusher skill set to a scheme that ranks 16th in sacks. This is the year.

list.name: L.Thornton Jr.
